title: The fixtures of test_issueTracker.py copy the whole issue store per test, which fails now and then with WinError 1450
author: Claude-JG
description: In pytest -n 8, the setup of four tests of test_issueTracker.py failed once in three runs (2026-10-17) with shutil.Error, [WinError 1450] not enough system resources, while copying the about 3000 issue files of tools/issueTracker/issues into the tmp directory of each test; the other runs pass. A store of a few issues, or one copy per worker, avoids it.
